# Fix Backend Connectivity - Action Plan
## Current Problem - Backend running on EC2:8080 but **NOT accessible** at `https://dev-api.broandbro.in/` - Frontend getting `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED` - Domain exists but not proxying to backend
---
## ✅ IMMEDIATE FIX (5 minutes)
### 1. Get EC2 Public IP ```bash aws ec2 describe-instances \ --instance-ids i-0f2ba63193349f4af \ --region us-east-1 \ --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].PublicIpAddress' \ --output text ```
Copy the returned IP (e.g., `54.123.45.67`)
### 2. Update Frontend Config Edit `frontend/.env.dev`: ``` VITE_API_URL=http://54.123.45.67:8080 ``` (Replace `54.123.45.67` with your actual EC2 IP)
### 3. Rebuild Frontend ```bash cd frontend npm run build:dev # Upload dist/ to your web server ```
### 4. Test Open browser DevTools Console: ```javascript fetch('http://54.123.45.67:8080/menu') .then(r => r.json()) .then(d => console.log(d)) ```
✅ Should return menu data!
---
## PRODUCTION FIX (After Testing Works)
Once you confirm the IP-based approach works, set up reverse proxy:
### Option A: Manual Setup on EC2 ```bash # SSH to your EC2 instance ssh -i your-key.pem ec2-user@54.123.45.67
# Download and run setup script curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/operationReact/qrapp/dev/setup-nginx-reverse-proxy.sh | sudo bash
# Or if you have the file locally sudo bash setup-nginx-reverse-proxy.sh dev-api.broandbro.in 8080 ```
### Option B: Add to GitHub Actions CI/CD Add this to your deployment workflow to auto-configure Nginx after backend starts.
### After Proxy Setup Update `frontend/.env.dev` back to: ``` VITE_API_URL=https://dev-api.broandbro.in ```
Then rebuild and deploy frontend.
---
## Checklist
- [ ] Get EC2 public IP - [ ] Update `frontend/.env.dev` with IP:8080 - [ ] Rebuild frontend: `npm run build:dev` - [ ] Deploy frontend build - [ ] Test API call in browser console - [ ] Confirm menu items load ✅ - [ ] (Optional) Setup Nginx reverse proxy for production - [ ] Update frontend config to use domain instead of IP - [ ] Rebuild and redeploy frontend
---
## Troubleshooting
| Issue | Solution | |-------|----------| | Still getting `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED` | EC2 security group doesn't allow port 8080. Check AWS console → EC2 → Security Groups | | IP address not found | EC2 might not have public IP. Check AWS console or terminate and restart with public IP | | Backend returns 502 Bad Gateway | Nginx working but backend not running on 8080. SSH to EC2 and check service status |
---
## Quick Commands Reference
```bash # Get EC2 IP aws ec2 describe-instances --instance-ids i-0f2ba63193349f4af --region us-east-1 --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].PublicIpAddress' --output text
# Check if backend is running (from EC2) curl http://localhost:8080/menu
# Check backend service status (from EC2) systemctl status <your-service-name>
# View backend logs (from EC2) journalctl -u <your-service-name> -n 100 --no-pager
# Test Nginx (from EC2) sudo nginx -t sudo systemctl restart nginx ```
---
## Backend Running On - **Server:** EC2 Instance `i-0f2ba63193349f4af` - **Port:** 8080 - **Database:** AWS RDS PostgreSQL - **Profile:** dev - **Status:** ✅ Running (deployment successful)

# Production Reverse Proxy Setup - Complete Summary
**Date:** August 15, 2026 **Status:** ✅ COMPLETE & READY TO DEPLOY **Estimated Deployment Time:** 16 minutes
---
## Problem Solved
**Before:** Frontend getting `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED` when calling backend - ❌ Backend running on EC2:8080 but not exposed - ❌ No reverse proxy to handle HTTPS - ❌ Domain not routing to backend
**After:** Production-ready reverse proxy deployment - ✅ Nginx reverse proxy configured - ✅ SSL/TLS with Let's Encrypt - ✅ Domain `https://dev-api.broandbro.in` routing to backend - ✅ CORS configured - ✅ Security headers enabled - ✅ Auto certificate renewal
---
## Files Created/Modified
### New Files Created (Setup & Documentation)
``` infra/ ├── ec2-reverse-proxy-setup.sh [NEW] ⭐ MAIN SETUP SCRIPT └── github-actions-setup-reverse-proxy.sh [NEW] CI/CD integration
Project Root: ├── START_HERE_REVERSE_PROXY_DEPLOYMENT.md [NEW] ⭐ START HERE! ├── REVERSE_PROXY_SETUP_SUMMARY.md [NEW] Summary & reference ├── REVERSE_PROXY_PRODUCTION_SETUP.md [NEW] Full technical guide └── REVERSE_PROXY_DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md [NEW] Step-by-step checklist ```
### Files Modified
``` backend/src/main/resources/application-dev.yml ├── Added: CORS configuration for dev environment ├── Before: No app.cors section └── After: app: cors: allowed-origins: "${APP_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS:https://develop.broandbro.in,http://localhost:5173}"
frontend/.env.dev ├── Changed: API URL updated for reverse proxy ├── Before: VITE_API_URL=http://YOUR_EC2_IP:8080 └── After: VITE_API_URL=https://dev-api.broandbro.in ```
---
## What Each File Does
### 1. **ec2-reverse-proxy-setup.sh** (THE MAIN ONE!)
```bash # Run this on EC2 instance to set up everything curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/operationReact/qrapp/dev/infra/ec2-reverse-proxy-setup.sh | \ sudo bash -s -- dev-api.broandbro.in 8080 admin@broandbro.in ```
**What it does:** - ✅ Installs Nginx & Certbot - ✅ Creates optimized Nginx config - ✅ Requests SSL certificate from Let's Encrypt - ✅ Enables HTTPS on port 443 - ✅ Redirects HTTP → HTTPS - ✅ Sets up auto-renewal - ✅ Starts Nginx service
**Time:** ~10 minutes (mostly waiting for certificate generation)
---
### 2. **Nginx Configuration** (Generated by setup script)
**Location:** `/etc/nginx/sites-available/backend-proxy`
**What it does:** - Listens on port 80 (HTTP) - Listens on port 443 (HTTPS with SSL) - Redirects all HTTP to HTTPS - Proxies requests to backend on localhost:8080 - Adds security headers - Logs all traffic - Handles WebSocket upgrades - Manages connection pooling
**Key Features:** ```nginx upstream backend { server 127.0.0.1:8080; keepalive 64; # Connection pooling }
server { listen 443 ssl http2; # HTTPS with HTTP/2 server_name dev-api.broandbro.in;
ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/dev-api.broandbro.in/fullchain.pem; ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/dev-api.broandbro.in/privkey.pem;
# Security headers add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" always; add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always; add_header X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN" always;
# Proxy configuration location / { proxy_pass http://backend; proxy_set_header Host $host; proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
proxy_read_timeout 300s; proxy_connect_timeout 300s; } } ```
---
### 3. **Backend CORS Configuration**
**File:** `backend/src/main/resources/application-dev.yml`
**Added:** ```yaml app: cors: allowed-origins: "${APP_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS:https://develop.broandbro.in,http://localhost:5173}" ```
**What it does:** - ✅ Allows requests from `https://develop.broandbro.in` (prod frontend) - ✅ Allows requests from `http://localhost:5173` (local dev) - ✅ Rejects requests from other origins (security)
**How to update:** ```bash # Add more origins export APP_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS="https://develop.broandbro.in,https://staging.broandbro.in"
# Or in systemd service Environment=APP_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=... ```
---
### 4. **Frontend Configuration**
**File:** `frontend/.env.dev`
**Changed from:** ``` VITE_API_URL=http://YOUR_EC2_IP:8080 ```
**Changed to:** ``` VITE_API_URL=https://dev-api.broandbro.in ```
**Impact:** - Frontend will call HTTPS domain (via Nginx) - No longer exposes raw backend IP - Uses reverse proxy for routing - SSL/TLS encrypted communication
---
## Security Improvements
### Before Reverse Proxy ``` ❌ Backend IP exposed (54.123.45.67:8080) ❌ Unencrypted HTTP communication ❌ No HTTPS ❌ No security headers ❌ No centralized logging ❌ No automatic certificate management ```
### After Reverse Proxy ``` ✅ Backend IP hidden (only accessible internally) ✅ All communication encrypted (HTTPS/TLS) ✅ Valid SSL certificate (Let's Encrypt) ✅ Security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.) ✅ Centralized logging & monitoring ✅ Automatic certificate renewal ✅ Connection pooling & optimization ```
---
## Deployment Architecture
``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐ │ User's Browser │ │ https://develop.broandbro.in │ └──────────────┬──────────────────────┘ │ HTTPS (TLS 1.2+) │ ┌──────────────▼──────────────────────┐ │ Nginx Reverse Proxy (Port 443) │ │ dev-api.broandbro.in │ │ │ │ • SSL/TLS Termination │ │ • Security Headers │ │ • Request Logging │ │ • Load Balancing (if needed) │ └──────────────┬──────────────────────┘ │ HTTP (internal) │ localhost:8080 ┌──────────────▼──────────────────────┐ │ Spring Boot Backend │ │ Instance: i-0f2ba63193349f4af │ │ Port: 8080 │ │ │ │ • REST API │ │ • Database Queries │ │ • Business Logic │ └──────────────┬──────────────────────┘ │ ┌──────────────▼──────────────────────┐ │ PostgreSQL Database (RDS) │ │ aws-region.rds.amazonaws.com │ └─────────────────────────────────────┘ ```
---
## ✅ Pre-Deployment Checklist
Before running the setup script, verify:
- [ ] EC2 instance is **running**: `i-0f2ba63193349f4af` - [ ] You can **SSH** to instance: `ssh -i key.pem ec2-user@IP` - [ ] Backend is **responding**: `curl http://localhost:8080/menu` (from EC2) - [ ] Domain **resolves** to EC2 IP: `nslookup dev-api.broandbro.in` - [ ] Security group allows **ports 80, 443** - [ ] You have **email** for SSL cert: `admin@broandbro.in`
---
## Deployment Steps (16 minutes total)
### Step 1: SSH to EC2 (1 minute) ```bash ssh -i your-key.pem ec2-user@YOUR_EC2_PUBLIC_IP ```
### Step 2: Run Setup Script (10 minutes) ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/operationReact/qrapp/dev/infra/ec2-reverse-proxy-setup.sh | \ sudo bash -s -- dev-api.broandbro.in 8080 admin@broandbro.in ```
**Waits for:** Script completes with `✅ Setup Complete!`
### Step 3: Verify Works (1 minute) ```bash curl -I https://dev-api.broandbro.in/menu # Expected: HTTP 200 or 401 ```
### Step 4: Rebuild Frontend (1 minute) ```bash cd frontend npm run build:dev ```
### Step 5: Deploy Frontend (2 minutes) ```bash # Upload frontend/dist/ to your web server # Accessible at: https://develop.broandbro.in ```
### Step 6: Test in Browser (1 minute) 1. Open `https://develop.broandbro.in` 2. Press F12 → Console 3. Check for NO red errors 4. Verify menu loads ✅
---
## Continuous Improvements
### Automatic - ✅ SSL certificate renews automatically every 90 days - ✅ Certificate renewal runs twice daily via `certbot.timer` - ✅ No manual intervention needed
### Manual (Optional) - Setup monitoring/alerting for certificate renewal - Setup centralized logging (ELK, CloudWatch) - Add rate limiting at Nginx level - Add WAF (Web Application Firewall) - Setup CDN for frontend assets
---
## Documentation Provided
| Document | Purpose | Audience | |----------|---------|----------| | `START_HERE_REVERSE_PROXY_DEPLOYMENT.md` | Quick start | Everyone | | `REVERSE_PROXY_SETUP_SUMMARY.md` | Overview & reference | Ops/Devs | | `REVERSE_PROXY_PRODUCTION_SETUP.md` | Technical deep-dive | DevOps/Architects | | `REVERSE_PROXY_DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md` | Step-by-step guide | Everyone deploying |
---
## What You Learned
- ✅ Reverse proxies hide backend infrastructure - ✅ Nginx can terminate SSL/TLS connections - ✅ Let's Encrypt provides free SSL certificates - ✅ CORS is important for security - ✅ Certbot automates certificate management - ✅ Security headers improve application security
---
## Troubleshooting Tips
### Setup Script Issues ```bash # Check backend is accessible curl http://localhost:8080/menu
# Check domain resolves nslookup dev-api.broandbro.in
# Check Nginx installation nginx -v ```
### After Deployment ```bash # Check Nginx is running sudo systemctl status nginx
# Check certificate sudo certbot certificates
# View Nginx logs sudo tail -f /var/log/nginx/backend_error.log
# Test connectivity curl -I https://dev-api.broandbro.in/menu ```
---
## ✨ Summary
**Created:** - ✅ 4 new documentation files - ✅ 2 setup scripts (direct + CI/CD) - ✅ Updated backend CORS config - ✅ Updated frontend API URL
**Status:** Ready to Deploy **Next Step:** Run setup script on EC2 **Time to Live:** ~16 minutes
---
**You're all set! **
Follow `START_HERE_REVERSE_PROXY_DEPLOYMENT.md` for immediate next steps.

# Production Reverse Proxy - Deployment Checklist
## Pre-Deployment (Before Running Setup)
- [ ] Backend is deployed and running on EC2 instance: `i-0f2ba63193349f4af` - [ ] Backend is accessible on localhost:8080 from EC2 ```bash ssh to EC2 && curl http://localhost:8080/menu ``` - [ ] Domain DNS points to EC2 public IP: `dev-api.broandbro.in` ```bash nslookup dev-api.broandbro.in # Should return EC2 public IP ``` - [ ] EC2 security group allows ports 80 and 443 - [ ] Email address for SSL cert: `admin@broandbro.in` ✅
---
## Phase 1: Setup Nginx Reverse Proxy (10 minutes)
### Option A: Automated (RECOMMENDED)
```bash # SSH to EC2 ssh -i your-key.pem ec2-user@YOUR_EC2_IP
# Run setup script curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/operationReact/qrapp/dev/infra/ec2-reverse-proxy-setup.sh | \ sudo bash -s -- dev-api.broandbro.in 8080 admin@broandbro.in ```
**Wait for:** ✅ Setup Complete message
- [ ] Dependencies installed (nginx, certbot) - [ ] Nginx configuration created - [ ] Nginx service restarted - [ ] SSL certificate generated - [ ] Auto-renewal enabled
### Option B: CI/CD Integration
Add to `.github/workflows/build-deploy-dev.yml`:
```yaml - name: Setup Nginx Reverse Proxy run: | bash infra/github-actions-setup-reverse-proxy.sh \ i-0f2ba63193349f4af \ dev-api.broandbro.in \ 8080 \ us-east-1 ```
---
## Phase 2: Verify Nginx is Working (5 minutes)
### Test from any machine:
```bash # Test HTTPS connection curl -I https://dev-api.broandbro.in/menu # Expected: HTTP 200 or 401 (connection successful)
# Test actual API response curl https://dev-api.broandbro.in/menu | jq . # Expected: JSON menu data or error (not connection refused)
# Check SSL certificate curl -I -v https://dev-api.broandbro.in/menu 2>&1 | grep -E "(SSL|certificate|issuer)" # Expected: Let's Encrypt certificate ```
- [ ] HTTPS connection successful (not ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED) - [ ] SSL certificate valid (Let's Encrypt) - [ ] Backend API responding through proxy
---
## Phase 3: Update Backend Config (2 minutes)
### File: `backend/src/main/resources/application-dev.yml`
Verify CORS is configured for dev frontend:
```yaml app: cors: allowed-origins: "${APP_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS:https://develop.broandbro.in,http://localhost:5173}" ```
- [ ] Backend CORS includes `https://develop.broandbro.in` - [ ] Backend CORS includes `http://localhost:5173` (for local dev)
### Deploy Backend Update
```bash cd backend ./gradlew bootJar # Deploy the updated JAR to EC2 ```
Or if already deployed, just set environment variable:
```bash export APP_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS="https://develop.broandbro.in,http://localhost:5173" # Restart backend service systemctl restart your-backend-service ```
- [ ] Backend restarted with updated CORS config
---
## Phase 4: Update Frontend Config (1 minute)
### File: `frontend/.env.dev`
Should already be updated to:
``` VITE_API_URL=https://dev-api.broandbro.in ```
- [ ] Frontend `.env.dev` uses `https://dev-api.broandbro.in` - [ ] Frontend `.env.development` still uses `http://localhost:8080` (local dev)
### Build for Dev Environment
```bash cd frontend npm run build:dev # Creates: frontend/dist/ ```
- [ ] Frontend built successfully - [ ] `dist/index.html` references correct API URL
### Deploy Frontend
Upload `frontend/dist/` to your web server (e.g., S3 + CloudFront)
- [ ] Frontend deployed to `https://develop.broandbro.in`
---
## Phase 5: Test End-to-End (5 minutes)
### 1. Test Frontend Loading
```bash # Open in browser https://develop.broandbro.in
# Open DevTools → Console (F12) # Should see NO red errors about API connection ```
- [ ] Frontend loads at `https://develop.broandbro.in` - [ ] No CORS errors in console - [ ] No `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED` errors
### 2. Test API Calls
In browser DevTools Console:
```javascript // Test menu endpoint fetch('https://dev-api.broandbro.in/menu') .then(r => r.json()) .then(d => console.log('✅ Menu loaded:', d.length, 'items')) .catch(e => console.error('❌ Error:', e))
// Test categories endpoint fetch('https://dev-api.broandbro.in/categories') .then(r => r.json()) .then(d => console.log('✅ Categories loaded:', d)) .catch(e => console.error('❌ Error:', e)) ```
Expected output: ``` ✅ Menu loaded: 15 items ✅ Categories loaded: Array(4) ```
- [ ] Menu API returns data - [ ] Categories API returns data - [ ] No CORS errors - [ ] No connection refused errors
### 3. Test UI Functionality
- [ ] Menu items display on page - [ ] Categories show in dropdown - [ ] Can navigate through menu - [ ] Can add items to cart - [ ] Can place order (if implemented)
- [ ] All UI features working
---
## Phase 6: SSL Certificate Management (Ongoing)
### Certificate Status
```bash # SSH to EC2 ssh -i your-key.pem ec2-user@YOUR_EC2_IP
# Check certificate expiration sudo certbot certificates # Should show certificate for dev-api.broandbro.in # Expires in ~90 days
# Dry-run renewal sudo certbot renew --dry-run # Should succeed without errors ```
- [ ] Certificate installed for `dev-api.broandbro.in` - [ ] Auto-renewal enabled - [ ] Dry-run renewal successful
### Renewal Schedule
- Auto-renewal runs automatically via `certbot.timer` - Renewal checks happen twice daily - Renewal triggers when certificate < 30 days from expiry - No manual action needed (unless failure)
---
## Phase 7: Monitoring & Logs (Ongoing)
### Check Logs from EC2
```bash # Nginx access log sudo tail -f /var/log/nginx/backend_access.log # Shows all requests to the proxy
# Nginx error log sudo tail -f /var/log/nginx/backend_error.log # Shows connection or routing issues
# Backend application log journalctl -u your-backend-service -n 50 --no-pager # Shows backend errors ```
- [ ] Setup log monitoring - [ ] Understand what each log shows
### Common Log Patterns
``` # Good request (200 OK) [10.0.0.1] "GET /menu HTTP/2.0" 200 1234 "https://develop.broandbro.in"
# Proxy error (backend down) [10.0.0.1] "GET /menu HTTP/2.0" 502 169 upstream timed out
# CORS pre-flight (OPTIONS) [10.0.0.1] "OPTIONS /menu HTTP/2.0" 200 0 ```
---
## Rollback Plan (If Something Goes Wrong)
If you need to revert to direct IP access:
1. **Update frontend `.env.dev`:** ``` VITE_API_URL=http://YOUR_EC2_IP:8080 ```
2. **Rebuild frontend:** ```bash npm run build:dev ```
3. **Redeploy frontend**
4. **Disable Nginx (if needed):** ```bash sudo systemctl stop nginx sudo systemctl disable nginx ```
---
## Success Criteria ✅
All items must be completed:
- [ ] Nginx reverse proxy running on EC2 - [ ] SSL certificate valid (Let's Encrypt) - [ ] Frontend loads at `https://develop.broandbro.in` - [ ] Backend API accessible at `https://dev-api.broandbro.in` - [ ] No CORS errors in browser - [ ] No `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED` errors - [ ] Menu and categories load correctly - [ ] API endpoints return data - [ ] SSL auto-renewal configured - [ ] Logs available for monitoring
---
## Timeline
| Phase | Task | Time | Status | |-------|------|------|--------| | 1 | Setup Nginx + SSL | 10 min | ⏳ | | 2 | Verify Nginx | 5 min | ⏳ | | 3 | Update Backend CORS | 2 min | ⏳ | | 4 | Rebuild Frontend | 1 min | ⏳ | | 5 | Test End-to-End | 5 min | ⏳ | | 6 | SSL Certificate Mgmt | - | ⏳ | | 7 | Setup Monitoring | - | ⏳ | | **TOTAL** | **All Phases** | **~23 min** | ⏳ |
---
## Support & Troubleshooting
### Issue: SSL Certificate Error
```bash # Manually renew sudo certbot renew --force-renewal
# Check status sudo certbot certificates
# Restart Nginx sudo systemctl restart nginx ```
### Issue: 502 Bad Gateway
```bash # Backend might be down curl http://localhost:8080/menu
# Check backend service systemctl status your-backend-service
# Check Nginx error log sudo tail -20 /var/log/nginx/backend_error.log ```
### Issue: CORS Error in Browser
```bash # Verify CORS headers curl -I -X OPTIONS https://dev-api.broandbro.in/menu \ -H "Origin: https://develop.broandbro.in" \ -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: GET"
# Should show: # Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://develop.broandbro.in
# If not, check APP_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var ```
### Issue: Connection Refused
```bash # Test Nginx curl -I https://dev-api.broandbro.in/menu
# Check Nginx status sudo systemctl status nginx
# Check if listening on port 443 sudo netstat -tlnp | grep nginx
# Restart Nginx sudo systemctl restart nginx ```
---
## Next Steps After Deployment
1. **Update documentation** - Add `https://dev-api.broandbro.in` to README - Update team on new URL
2. **Setup monitoring** - Configure CloudWatch/ELK for logs - Setup alerts for certificate renewal failures
3. **Consider additional features** - Add rate limiting at Nginx level - Add WAF (Web Application Firewall) - Setup CDN for static assets - Add caching headers for API responses
4. **Performance tuning** - Monitor response times - Adjust Nginx buffer sizes if needed - Enable gzip compression
---
**Date Started:** August 15, 2026 **Current Status:** Ready to Deploy **Estimated Completion:** August 15, 2026 (~23 minutes)

# Production-Ready Reverse Proxy Setup Guide
## Overview
This guide sets up Nginx as a reverse proxy in front of your backend service, enabling: - ✅ HTTPS/SSL encryption with Let's Encrypt - ✅ Domain-based access (`https://dev-api.broandbro.in`) - ✅ Automatic HTTP → HTTPS redirect - ✅ Security headers and best practices - ✅ SSL certificate auto-renewal - ✅ Connection pooling and optimized timeouts
---
## Architecture
``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Frontend (develop.broandbro.in) │ │ npm run build:dev │ └────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘ │ HTTPS ↓ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Nginx Reverse Proxy (Port 443) │ │ • SSL/TLS termination │ │ • Request routing │ │ • Security headers │ │ • Logging │ └────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘ │ HTTP (internal) ↓ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Spring Boot Backend (localhost:8080) │ │ • API endpoints │ │ • Database queries │ │ • Business logic │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ```
---
## Quick Setup (Automated)
### Option 1: Run Setup Script Directly on EC2
```bash # SSH to your EC2 instance ssh -i your-key.pem ec2-user@YOUR_EC2_PUBLIC_IP
# Download and run the setup script curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/operationReact/qrapp/dev/infra/ec2-reverse-proxy-setup.sh | \ sudo bash -s -- dev-api.broandbro.in 8080 admin@broandbro.in ```
Expected output: ``` ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ ✅ Setup Complete! ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Configuration Summary: • Domain: https://dev-api.broandbro.in • Backend: http://127.0.0.1:8080 • Nginx Config: /etc/nginx/sites-available/backend-proxy • SSL Cert: /etc/letsencrypt/live/dev-api.broandbro.in/ • Access Log: /var/log/nginx/backend_access.log • Error Log: /var/log/nginx/backend_error.log
Test the setup: curl -I https://dev-api.broandbro.in/menu ```
### Option 2: Integration into GitHub Actions (CI/CD)
Add this step to your `.github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml`:
```yaml - name: Setup Nginx Reverse Proxy run: | bash infra/github-actions-setup-reverse-proxy.sh \ i-0f2ba63193349f4af \ dev-api.broandbro.in \ 8080 \ us-east-1 env: AWS_ROLE_ARN: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_ARN }} AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1 ```
---
## Manual Setup (Step-by-Step)
If you prefer to set up manually:
### 1. SSH to EC2 ```bash ssh -i your-key.pem ec2-user@YOUR_EC2_PUBLIC_IP ```
### 2. Install Nginx and Certbot ```bash sudo apt-get update sudo apt-get install -y nginx certbot python3-certbot-nginx ```
### 3. Create Nginx Configuration ```bash sudo tee /etc/nginx/sites-available/backend-proxy > /dev/null << 'EOF' upstream backend { server 127.0.0.1:8080; keepalive 64; }
server { listen 80; server_name dev-api.broandbro.in;
location /.well-known/acme-challenge/ { root /var/www/certbot; }
location / { return 301 https://$server_name$request_uri; } }
server { listen 443 ssl http2; server_name dev-api.broandbro.in;
ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/dev-api.broandbro.in/fullchain.pem; ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/dev-api.broandbro.in/privkey.pem;
ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3; ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5; ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on; ssl_session_cache shared:SSL:10m; ssl_session_timeout 10m;
add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" always; add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always; add_header X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN" always;
access_log /var/log/nginx/backend_access.log combined; error_log /var/log/nginx/backend_error.log warn;
location / { proxy_pass http://backend;
proxy_set_header Host $host; proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Connection "";
proxy_connect_timeout 300s; proxy_send_timeout 300s; proxy_read_timeout 300s; } } EOF ```
### 4. Enable and Test ```bash sudo ln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/backend-proxy /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/ sudo rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default sudo nginx -t sudo systemctl restart nginx ```
### 5. Setup SSL with Let's Encrypt ```bash sudo mkdir -p /var/www/certbot
sudo certbot certonly --webroot \ -w /var/www/certbot \ -d dev-api.broandbro.in \ --email admin@broandbro.in \ --agree-tos \ --non-interactive
# Restart Nginx to apply SSL sudo systemctl restart nginx ```
### 6. Enable Auto-Renewal ```bash sudo systemctl enable certbot.timer sudo systemctl start certbot.timer ```

``` Nginx Reverse Proxy ├─ Acts as intermediary between client and backend ├─ Handles SSL/TLS encryption ├─ Routes requests to backend ├─ Logs all traffic └─ Can scale to multiple backends

#!/bin/bash # GitHub Actions - Run this in your CI/CD after backend deployment # Automatically setup Nginx reverse proxy on EC2
INSTANCE_ID="$1" DOMAIN="$2" BACKEND_PORT="${3:-8080}" AWS_REGION="${4:-us-east-1}"
if [ -z "$INSTANCE_ID" ] || [ -z "$DOMAIN" ]; then echo "❌ Usage: $0 <instance-id> <domain> [backend-port] [aws-region]" echo "Example: $0 i-0f2ba63193349f4af dev-api.broandbro.in 8080 us-east-1" exit 1 fi
echo " Setting up Nginx reverse proxy via SSM" echo "Instance: $INSTANCE_ID" echo "Domain: $DOMAIN" echo "Backend Port: $BACKEND_PORT"
# Create setup command SETUP_CMD="curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/operationReact/qrapp/dev/infra/ec2-reverse-proxy-setup.sh | sudo bash -s -- $DOMAIN $BACKEND_PORT admin@broandbro.in"
# Send command via SSM COMMAND_ID=$(aws ssm send-command \ --instance-ids "$INSTANCE_ID" \ --document-name "AWS-RunShellScript" \ --parameters "commands=[\"$SETUP_CMD\"]" \ --timeout-seconds 300 \ --region "$AWS_REGION" \ --output text \ --query 'Command.CommandId')
echo "SSM Command ID: $COMMAND_ID"
# Poll for completion echo "⏳ Waiting for setup to complete..." for i in {1..60}; do sleep 5
INVOCATION=$(aws ssm get-command-invocation \ --command-id "$COMMAND_ID" \ --instance-id "$INSTANCE_ID" \ --region "$AWS_REGION" 2>/dev/null || echo '{}')
STATUS=$(echo "$INVOCATION" | python3 -c \ "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('Status','Pending'))" 2>/dev/null || echo "Pending")
echo " [$i/60] $STATUS"
if [ "$STATUS" = "Success" ]; then echo "" echo "✅ Nginx reverse proxy setup successful!" echo "" echo " Next steps:" echo "1. Update frontend/.env.dev to: VITE_API_URL=https://$DOMAIN" echo "2. Rebuild frontend: npm run build:dev" echo "3. Deploy frontend" exit 0 elif [ "$STATUS" = "Failed" ] || [ "$STATUS" = "Cancelled" ]; then echo "" echo "❌ Setup failed with status: $STATUS" echo "" echo "Output:" echo "$INVOCATION" | python3 -c \ "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('StandardOutputContent','')); print(d.get('StandardErrorContent',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "Check AWS Systems Manager for details" exit 1 fi done
echo "❌ Timed out waiting for setup" exit 1
